title: DP-MERF
summary: Research code implementing DP-MERF, a differentially private data generation method based on random Fourier features, with tabular experiments benchmarked on standard datasets. The tabular data loader and single-generator training script import sdgym's load_dataset to fetch and preprocess benchmark tabular datasets for evaluation.
needs: sdgym used only for dataset loading utility; no synthesizer algorithm from sdv family is invoked
